candidates.change_summary: Replace the additive update `imBalances[to] += creditsIssued` with an assignment `imBalances[to] = creditsIssued`, overwriting any existing balance instead of accumulating.
Credit the caller (`msg.sender`) instead of the intended recipient `to`, so imBalances differs at keys distinct from the supplied address.
Delete the balance-update statement so the supplied tokens never credit any imBalances entry.
Credit the contract itself (`address(this)`) instead of the recipient `to`.

Set `_status = _NOT_ENTERED` in `_nonReentrantBefore` instead of `_ENTERED`, disabling the guard so a reentrant call to supplyTokenTo can alter imBalances at arbitrary keys before the outer call's credit is applied.
